mapper.select: SELECT YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date) AS ym, SUM(b.purchase_price * b.initial_quantity) AS amount FROM stock_batch b WHERE b.family_id = #{familyId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.purchase_date IS NOT NULL AND b.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} GROUP BY YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date) ORDER BY ym

SELECT YEAR(d.disposal_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.disposal_date) AS ym, SUM(d.amount) AS amount FROM disposal_record d WHERE d.family_id = #{familyId} AND d.action IN ('DISPOSED', 'RETURNED') AND d.amount IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(d.disposal_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.disposal_date) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} GROUP BY YEAR(d.disposal_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.disposal_date) ORDER BY ym

SELECT YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date) AS ym, COALESCE(f.dosage_form, '未标注') AS category, SUM(b.purchase_price * b.initial_quantity) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS batches FROM stock_batch b JOIN family_drug f ON f.id = b.family_drug_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE b.family_id = #{familyId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.purchase_date IS NOT NULL AND b.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} GROUP BY YEAR(b.purchase_date) * 100 + MONTH(b.purchase_date), COALESCE(f.dosage_form, '未标注') ORDER BY ym, amount DESC
